fields.label: Statement Section
fields.options:
A. Earned Pay
B. Separation Benefits
C. Recoveries
D. Statutory Deductions
F. Paid Outside GDL
fields.description: A and B are paid to the employee, C is recovered from them, D and F are shown for information only.

fields.label: Account
fields.description: Expense account for a payable, receivable account for a recovery. Blank: taken from the Salary Component for the company.

fields.label: Always Add
fields.description: Add the row even when the amount works out to zero.

fields.label: Formula
fields.description: An expression that returns the amount, for example BS * 15 / 26 * service_years

fields.label: Available Values
fields.options: Salary component abbreviations from the employee's last salary slip (for example BS), gross_pay, net_pay, service_years, service_months, completed_years, notice_days, notice_served_days, notice_shortfall_days, bond_amount, bond_unserved_ratio, and min, max, round.

fields.label: Applies To Separation Types
fields.description: Leave blank to apply to every separation type.
